definitions.gloss: clean, neat impression; a fresh, well-groomed look
definitions.explanation: The impression of being clean, tidy and well-groomed that a person, outfit or place gives. Very common when talking about appearance, job interviews and dating.

examples.japanese: {清潔感|せいけつかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
⟦{面接|めんせつ}→面接：01100_mensetsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{清潔感|せいけつかん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{服装|ふくそう}→服装：03594_fukusou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: At a job interview, neat, clean-looking clothes are important.

examples.japanese: ⟦{髪|かみ}→髪：02196_kami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{短|みじか}く→短い：00510_mijikai⟧⟦{切|き}ったら→切る：02693_kiru⟧、{清潔感|せいけつかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}て→出る：00513_deru⟧⟦{若|わか}く→若い：00823_wakai⟧⟦{見|み}える→見える：01165_mieru⟧ようになった。
examples.english: After cutting my hair short, I look fresh and neat and seem younger.

notes:
⟦{清潔|せいけつ}→清潔：01583_seiketsu⟧ (clean) + ⟦{感|かん}→〜感：28578_kan⟧ (sense, feeling). It is about the impression, not literal hygiene: wrinkled clothes or messy hair can lack {清潔感|せいけつかん} even if freshly washed.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {清潔感|せいけつかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ / ⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: to look neat / scruffy
- {清潔感|せいけつかん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{服装|ふくそう}→服装：03594_fukusou⟧: neat, clean-looking clothes
- {清潔感|せいけつかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧: to make oneself look neat

CULTURAL NOTE:
One of the most frequently named qualities in Japanese advice on job hunting and in surveys of what people want in a partner.
